TaskForce is moving to your desktop.

Your projects, issues and Brain OS in one app, on your own computer. And Claude Code when an issue needs a hand.

Download for Windows: https://taskforce-project.fr/download
Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. Also for Linux, and soon macOS.


Hi {{ contact.FIRSTNAME|default:"there" }},

You were one of the first people to use TaskForce, so you are among the first to hear it: TaskForce is now a desktop app. Same account, same interface, and your work stays with you.


PLAN, HAND OVER, REMEMBER

- Plan: projects, issues, cycles and a roadmap, on a board.
- Hand over: Claude Code takes an issue and works on your computer.
- Remember: the Brain OS links your pages to each other and to your projects.

It all stays with you: your projects live on your computer, the app sends no usage data, and it works offline once you are signed in.


THREE STEPS, AND YOU ARE IN (WINDOWS)

1. Download: TaskForce-Setup-1.2.1.exe, from https://taskforce-project.fr/download
2. Install: no administrator rights needed.
3. Sign in: with your TaskForce account.

If Windows hesitates, that is expected: the installer is not signed yet. The install guide explains each message: https://taskforce-project.fr/download#install
The VirusTotal report shows the scan of the file: https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/fbde7957158d715ba9b626e6056cd466da49f00af149d4b72f0a33e3a46a79c0
Need a hand? Email me at contact@taskforce-project.fr and I will walk you through it.
After that, the app updates itself.


BRING IT ALONG, OR START FRESH

I already use TaskForce
Sign in with the same account, then Operations, From the web app, Copy everything: your workspaces arrive with their Brain OS and projects.
It is a copy: the web app keeps everything until it closes (date to come, an email will tell you). To redo: teammates, connections and AI settings.
Moving from the web app: https://taskforce-project.fr/migrate

I'm starting fresh
Create your free account from the app, go through the three-step setup, then create your first project.
Claude Code connects in one click in Settings, Agents, if it is installed and signed in to your account.


BUILT IN THE OPEN

All the code is public, under the AGPL-3.0 license. No need to code to help: a two-line email counts too.
- Explore the project and star it: https://github.com/taskforce-project/taskforce-fullstack
- Share feedback: https://github.com/taskforce-project/taskforce-fullstack/issues/new/choose or contact@taskforce-project.fr


The best way to judge it is to try it on a real project. Tell me what you think.

Download for Windows: https://taskforce-project.fr/download

Pierre
Pierre Michel, creator of TaskForce
